newsitem.title: USA: Two bodies found in Dallas bagel store freezer.
newsitem.headline: Two bodies found in Dallas bagel store freezer.

text.p: The manager of a Dallas bagel store made a shocking discovery Friday morning when he opened a walk-in freezer and found two bodies inside, police said.
The manager of Brueggers Bagel in north Dallas opened the shop before dawn and found the bodies of store supervisor Samuel May, 21, and his friend Dean Chisamore, 20, inside the freezer, police said.
Both men had been shot to death inside the store, and money had been stolen.

But it was not clear whether May, who had store keys in his pocket, and Chisamore took part in the robbery and were then killed and dumped in the freezer or whether they were kidnapped and forced to let the thieves in.
The manager had locked up the empty store late Thursday, and May was not scheduled to work Friday morning. He had worked at the store for about a year and was recently promoted to supervisor.

"There was no forced entry so they apparently entered by using May's keys," Dallas Police Department spokesman Sgt. Jim Chandler said. "What we don't know is whether it was voluntary on his part or whether he was forced to take someone back there."
Detectives said they had not yet identified the suspects.
